# Latin American Colonial Navy
The [bold]Latin American Colonial Navy[/bold] (LACN) is a branch of the [textlink="United Americas" link="CMUGuideLoreUA"]' space forces. Its [bold]Landing Forces[/bold] specialize in rapid deployment and shock tactics for planetary assault and occupation.
